blocks.source: 【RPG制作講座】エンカウントシステム
blocks.translation: RPG Design Guides: Encounter Systems

blocks.source: エンカウントシステムとは、戦闘システムの入口に当たる部分であり、プレイヤーが敵と戦闘を開始するためのシステムである。
blocks.translation: An encounter system is the gateway to the battle system: it is the system that allows the player to begin battles with enemies.

blocks.source: 古くはドラクエシリーズを中心にランダムエンカウントが主流だったが、時代の変化と共に、この部分にも様々な工夫が加えられるようになった。
blocks.translation: In the past, random encounters were the norm, particularly in the Dragon Quest series. However, as times have changed, various innovations have been introduced to this aspect as well.

blocks.source: そこで既存のＲＰＧが、どの様な工夫を凝らしているのかをまとめてみた。
blocks.translation: I therefore decided to summarize the various innovations used in existing RPGs.

blocks.source: 以下に、大雑把な分類を行うが、その分類の中であっても、作品によって様々な特徴付けがなされている。
blocks.translation: The following is a rough classification, but even within each category, individual games employ a variety of distinguishing features.

blocks.source: 具体的には『戦闘を回避する手段』や『戦闘前の駆け引き』といった要素で差別化するパターンが多いようだ。
blocks.translation: In particular, many games seem to differentiate themselves through elements such as ways to avoid battles and pre-battle strategy.

blocks.source: そのため、作品の例を挙げながら解説をしていきたい。
blocks.translation: For that reason, I will explain each type while giving examples from various games.

blocks.source: ランダムエンカウント（歩行エンカウント）
blocks.translation: Random Encounters (Walking Encounters)

blocks.source: 歩行時に確率等によって、戦闘に突入する古典的なエンカウントシステム。ＦＣ～ＰＳ時代の大半のＲＰＧはこれを採用している。固定された歩数で戦闘になる作品にまで、ランダムという呼称を使うのはおかしいのだが、同じ種類のものとして分類する。
blocks.translation: This is a classic encounter system in which battles begin while walking, based on probability or similar factors. Most RPGs from the Famicom through PlayStation eras used this system. Strictly speaking, it is odd to call games that trigger battles after a fixed number of steps “random,” but I have classified them as the same type.

blocks.source: 地形によって戦闘に突入する確率を変更したり、敵の種類を変えたりといったような工夫がされることが多い。
blocks.translation: Games often include features such as changing the encounter rate or enemy types depending on the terrain.

blocks.source: 【利点】
blocks.translation: [Advantages]

blocks.source: 手間がかからない。
blocks.translation: Requires little effort.

blocks.source: シンプルで分かりやすい。
blocks.translation: Simple and easy to understand.

blocks.source: 【欠点】
blocks.translation: [Disadvantages]

blocks.source: 戦闘前の駆け引きがないので単調。
blocks.translation: It is monotonous because there is no pre-battle strategy.

blocks.source: 視覚的に地味。（ただし、落ち着いているともいえる）
blocks.translation: Visually unremarkable. (Though it could also be described as calm.)

blocks.source: 【作品例】
blocks.translation: [Examples]

blocks.source: ドラゴンクエスト１～８
blocks.translation: Dragon Quest I–VIII

blocks.source: ランダムエンカウントといえば、かつてのドラクエシリーズ。
blocks.translation: When you think of random encounters, you think of the classic Dragon Quest series.

blocks.source: 地形によってエンカウント率が変化したり、聖水によって弱い敵との戦闘を回避できる。
blocks.translation: The encounter rate changes depending on the terrain, and Holy Water can be used to avoid battles with weak enemies.

blocks.source: ワイルドアームズシリーズ
blocks.translation: The Wild Arms Series

blocks.source: 『エンカウントキャンセル』というシステムが特徴。
blocks.translation: The series is known for its “Encounter Cancel” system.

blocks.source: 戦闘前にキャラクターの頭上に『！』のアイコンが表示されるので、そのタイミングでキャンセルボタンを押すと、戦闘を回避できるというもの。回避できるかどうかの条件は作品によってまちまち。
blocks.translation: An “!” icon appears above the character before battle. Pressing the cancel button at that moment allows you to avoid the battle. The conditions for successfully avoiding it vary from game to game.

blocks.source: シンボルエンカウント
blocks.translation: Symbol Encounters

blocks.source: マップ上を動きまわる敵シンボルと接触することで、戦闘画面に切り替わる。
blocks.translation: Touching an enemy symbol moving around the map switches the game to the battle screen.

blocks.source: ＦＣ～ＰＳ時代は少数派だったが、ＰＳ２以降の作品では採用例も多くなっている。
blocks.translation: This was uncommon during the Famicom through PlayStation eras, but it has been used much more frequently in games released since the PlayStation 2.

blocks.source: 【利点】
blocks.translation: [Advantages]

blocks.source: 敵に『当たるか』『避けるか』というように、プレイヤーが必要に応じて戦闘を行う事ができる。ランダムエンカウントでは、課題となる部分をある程度プレイヤー側で吸収してくれるので、ある意味では難易度調整がしやすいかも。
blocks.translation: The player can choose whether to fight as needed—whether to engage an enemy or avoid it. With random encounters, the player absorbs some of the difficulty inherent in this decision, so in a sense, balancing the difficulty may be easier.

blocks.source: 「好みの敵種族を狙い撃ちする」「手強い敵を避ける」というように、プレイヤーが戦略を立てることも可能となる。
blocks.translation: Players can also develop strategies, such as targeting their preferred enemy species or avoiding formidable enemies.

blocks.source: 敵シンボルによって、視覚的にマップを彩る効果がある。
blocks.translation: Enemy symbols visually add color to the map.

blocks.source: その時点では倒せない巨大モンスターが歩いているといった設定も可能。
blocks.translation: It is also possible to have giant monsters roaming around that the player cannot defeat at that point in the game.

blocks.source: 【欠点】
blocks.translation: [Disadvantages]

blocks.source: シンボルのグラフィックを用意したり、配置したり、行動パターンをプログラムしたりと手間がかかる。
blocks.translation: It takes effort to prepare and place symbol graphics and program their behavior patterns.

blocks.source: プレイヤーがシンボルを回避できるよう、マップにある程度の幅が必要となる。
blocks.translation: The map needs to have a certain amount of space so that players can avoid the symbols.

blocks.source: プレイスタイルの幅が広いため、制作者が予期しないことをするプレイヤーが出現しやすい。
blocks.translation: Because the range of play styles is broad, players are more likely to do things the creator did not anticipate.

blocks.source: 避けやすいシンボルや、倒しても旨みのないシンボル等、全くプレイヤーに相手にされない敵が出てしまう場合も。等々……ランダムエンカウントとは別視点でのバランス調整術が要求される。
blocks.translation: Some enemies may be completely ignored by players, such as symbols that are easy to avoid or provide little benefit even when defeated. And so on… This requires a different approach to balance adjustments than random encounters.

blocks.source: 筆者自身、シンボルエンカウントで長編を作成したけれど、特にマップの幅の問題は非常に大きい。
blocks.translation: I myself created a long game using symbol encounters, and the issue of map width in particular was extremely significant.

blocks.source: 細い道を軽々しく作れないため、マップ全体を大きめに作る必要がある。
blocks.translation: Since narrow paths cannot be created casually, the entire map needs to be made relatively large.

blocks.source: システム面の実装と合わせて、ゲーム全体の工数が馬鹿にならない規模でふくらむ可能性がある。
blocks.translation: Together with implementing the system itself, this can cause the total amount of work for the game to expand to a considerable scale.

blocks.source: 【作品例】
blocks.translation: [Examples]

blocks.source: リンクの冒険（ディスクシステム）
blocks.translation: Zelda II: The Adventure of Link (Disk System)

blocks.source: ゼルダの伝説シリーズの第２作で、横スクロールアクション型の戦闘が特徴。
blocks.translation: The second game in The Legend of Zelda series, it is known for its side-scrolling action-style battles.

blocks.source: 名作だがわりと存在を忘れられがちなゲーム。
blocks.translation: It is a classic, but a game whose existence is fairly often forgotten.

blocks.source: 道の上は安全だが、道を外れると敵シンボルが出現し、近寄ってくる。
blocks.translation: The roads are safe, but leaving them causes enemy symbols to appear and approach you.

blocks.source: 敵に触れた際の地形によって、戦闘内容が大きく変化する。
blocks.translation: The content of the battle changes dramatically depending on the terrain where the enemy is touched.

blocks.source: 敵シンボルの色によって、敵の構成が変化する。
blocks.translation: The enemy party changes depending on the color of the enemy symbol.

blocks.source: ダンジョン内部に付いては、普通の横スクロール型アクションとなる。
blocks.translation: Inside dungeons, the game becomes a standard side-scrolling action game.

blocks.source: というように、１９８７年発売の作品ながら凝った構成。僕の知る限りでは、シンボルエンカウントの作品としては最も古い。
blocks.translation: Thus, despite being released in 1987, it has an elaborate structure. As far as I know, it is the oldest game to use symbol encounters.

blocks.source: サガシリーズ（ロマンシングサガ以降）
blocks.translation: The SaGa Series (From Romancing SaGa Onward)

blocks.source: シンボルエンカウントといえばこのシリーズ。
blocks.translation: When it comes to symbol encounters, this is the series that comes to mind.

blocks.source: 「敵の背後を取ると先制できる」
blocks.translation: "You can get the first strike by getting behind an enemy."

blocks.source: 「ダッシュ中、敵に触れると陣形が崩れる」
blocks.translation: "While dashing, touching an enemy disrupts your formation."

blocks.source: というように戦闘開始時の状況によって、有利不利が変化する。
blocks.translation: As in these examples, the advantages and disadvantages change depending on the situation at the start of battle.

blocks.source: 初代ロマンシングサガにおいて、草原を動きまわる恐竜（序盤に戦うと瞬殺）の姿が印象深い。
blocks.translation: In the original Romancing SaGa, the sight of dinosaurs roaming the grasslands (which can instantly kill you if fought early on) is particularly memorable.

blocks.source: マザー２
blocks.translation: Mother 2

blocks.source: 接触時、近くにいるシンボルも巻き込んで戦闘になる。それにより一度に戦う敵の数が決まる。弱い敵は戦闘画面に切り替わるまでもなく瞬殺できる便利な仕様もある。
blocks.translation: When you make contact, nearby enemy symbols are also drawn into the battle. This determines how many enemies you fight at once. There is also the convenient feature that weak enemies can be instantly killed without even switching to the battle screen.

blocks.source: エストポリス伝記２
blocks.translation: Lufia II: Rise of the Sinistrals

blocks.source: 不思議のダンジョンシリーズのように、こちらが一歩動く度に敵シンボルも動く。弓矢で敵を射って動きを止めるといった駆け引きも可能。
blocks.translation: As in the Mystery Dungeon series, enemy symbols move every time you move one step. You can also employ tactics such as shooting enemies with a bow and arrow to stop them from moving.

blocks.source: 他作品のいいとこ取りと言われる作品だが、何気にＲＰＧでこれを採用している作品は希少。
blocks.translation: It is said to take the best elements from other games, but surprisingly few RPGs adopt this feature.

blocks.source: ちなみに、フィールド上のみランダムエンカウントだったりする。
blocks.translation: Incidentally, random encounters occur only in the field.

blocks.source: 固定エンカウント
blocks.translation: Fixed Encounters

blocks.source: 特定の地点に必ず敵が存在する。シンボルエンカウントとは異なり避けられない相手も多い。正直、手間がかかる割にゲーム的な旨みは薄い気がするので、これを基本とするのは余りお勧めし辛い。
blocks.translation: Enemies are always present at specific locations. Unlike symbol encounters, many of these opponents cannot be avoided. Honestly, considering the effort involved, I feel they offer little in terms of gameplay value, so I cannot particularly recommend using them as the default.

blocks.source: 【利点】
blocks.translation: [Advantages]

blocks.source: プレイヤーの戦闘回数や得られる経験値を予想しやすい。
blocks.translation: It is easy to predict how many battles the player will fight and how much experience they will gain.

blocks.source: 【欠点】
blocks.translation: [Disadvantages]

blocks.source: シンボルエンカウント同様に手間が掛かる。
blocks.translation: They are just as much work as symbol encounters.

blocks.source: 特定の場所で必ず戦闘になるという仕組みはプレイヤーに取って面倒かも。
blocks.translation: Having battles occur at specific locations every time may be a hassle for players.

blocks.source: 【作品例】
blocks.translation: [Examples]

blocks.source: クロノトリガー
blocks.translation: Chrono Trigger

blocks.source: シンボルエンカウントとの複合型だが、進行上の強制戦闘も多い。戦闘突入前の敵のアクションがいちいち凝っている。見かけ上はシームレスに戦闘に切り替わるが、移動時と戦闘時は明確に分かれている。
blocks.translation: It combines fixed encounters with symbol encounters, but it also has many forced battles required for progression. The enemies' actions before entering battle are elaborately designed. Although the transition to battle appears seamless, movement and battle are clearly separate.

blocks.source: ミスティッククエスト（ＦＦＵＳＡ）
blocks.translation: Mystic Quest (FFUSA)

blocks.source: 敵シンボルの場所が完全に固定されており、先に進むためには必ず敵と戦わなければならない。
blocks.translation: Enemy symbols are placed in completely fixed locations, and you must fight them to proceed.

blocks.source: 何というか分かりやすいゲームシステムではあるが、プレイの幅は狭い。
blocks.translation: It is an easy-to-understand game system, in a sense, but it offers little variety in how you play.

blocks.source: 任意エンカウント
blocks.translation: Optional Encounters

blocks.source: 戦闘を行うかどうかを任意に決めることができる。ライブアライブの幕末編のように、仕掛けが豊富な作品に組み込むのもよいかも。
blocks.translation: You can choose whether or not to engage in battle. It might work well in a game with plenty of mechanisms, such as the Bakumatsu chapter of Live A Live.

blocks.source: なお、シンボルエンカウントについて回避を容易にした場合、実質的に任意エンカウントに近いものになる。
blocks.translation: Incidentally, if avoiding symbol encounters is made easy, they effectively become a form of optional encounter.

blocks.source: 【利点・欠点】
blocks.translation: [Advantages and Disadvantages]

blocks.source: 基本的にはシンボルエンカウントと同じだが、利点も欠点も更に極端になる。バランス調整をやりやすくするために強制エンカウントを挟む方法もあるが、持ち味も削れるので調整が難しい。
blocks.translation: Basically, they are the same as symbol encounters, but both their advantages and disadvantages become more extreme. One approach is to insert forced encounters to make balance adjustments easier, but this also diminishes their distinctive character, making adjustment difficult.

blocks.source: 【作品例】
blocks.translation: [Examples]

blocks.source: すばらしきこのせかい
blocks.translation: The World Ends with You

blocks.source: 敵を『スキャン』することで、戦闘する敵を選ぶ方式。基本的には自分から仕掛けなければ敵は襲ってこない。
blocks.translation: You choose which enemies to fight by "scanning" them. Basically, enemies will not attack unless you initiate the encounter.

blocks.source: ただし、このゲームの場合、シナリオ進行上で倒さなければならない敵もそれなりに存在する。また、後半はマップ切替時に強制戦闘が入っていたりしてちょっと面倒だったりする。
blocks.translation: However, in this game, there are still a fair number of enemies that must be defeated to advance the story. Also, the latter half includes forced battles when changing maps, which can be a little tedious.

blocks.source: ライブアライブ・幕末編
blocks.translation: Live A Live — Bakumatsu Chapter

blocks.source: 主人公は忍者で『隠れ蓑』によって、姿を消す能力を持つ。というように、戦闘を避けることがゲームシステムとして組み込まれている。ボスを除いて、倒す必要がある敵は存在しないし、固定された場所にいる敵もギミックを駆使したり、別の道を通ることで無視できる。
blocks.translation: The protagonist is a ninja who can conceal himself using "Disguise." Thus, avoiding battles is incorporated into the game system. Apart from bosses, there are no enemies that must be defeated, and even enemies in fixed locations can be ignored by using mechanisms or taking another route.

blocks.source: ドラゴンクエストシリーズの銀の竪琴や＆口笛
blocks.translation: Dragon Quest series' Silver Harp and & Whistle

blocks.source: 魔物を呼び出す効果を持つ。
blocks.translation: They have the effect of summoning monsters.

blocks.source: 自由に戦闘を行えるので、任意エンカウントの一種と考えることができる。
blocks.translation: Since you can engage in battles freely, they can be considered a type of optional encounter.

blocks.source: シームレス
blocks.translation: Seamless

blocks.source: 画面の切り替わりなしで、その場でリアルタイム型の戦闘を行う。移動時と戦闘時の境界が薄い。
blocks.translation: Real-time battles take place on the spot without switching screens. The boundary between movement and battle is blurred.

blocks.source: 【利点】
blocks.translation: [Advantages]

blocks.source: 画面切り替えがないのでスムーズ。
blocks.translation: The experience is smooth because there are no screen transitions.

blocks.source: 戦闘前の駆け引き要素を入れやすい。
blocks.translation: It is easy to include tactical elements before battle.

blocks.source: 【欠点】
blocks.translation: [Disadvantages]

blocks.source: やはり手間が掛かる。特にプログラム的な難易度が高い。
blocks.translation: They are still a lot of work. In particular, the programming difficulty is high.

blocks.source: 移動に操作を取られるため、複数キャラクターに命令できるようなシステムとの共存は難しい。返って戦闘が単調になることも。
blocks.translation: Since the player must control movement, it is difficult to combine this with a system that allows commands to be issued to multiple characters. Battles can even become monotonous as a result.

blocks.source: 【作品例】
blocks.translation: [Examples]

blocks.source: ファイナルファンタジー１２
blocks.translation: Final Fantasy XII

blocks.source: マップ上を動きまわる敵に対して、攻撃を仕掛けたり仕掛けられたりする事で、戦闘になる。「一度に多くの敵を相手にしない」「強い敵に喧嘩を売らない」といった戦闘前の駆け引きがある。ゼノブレイドなども同様。
blocks.translation: Battles begin when you attack enemies moving around the map or are attacked by them. There are tactical decisions to make before battle, such as "Don't take on too many enemies at once" and "Don't pick a fight with a strong enemy." Xenoblade is similar.

blocks.source: キングダムハーツシリーズ
blocks.translation: Kingdom Hearts series

blocks.source: 自由自在にマップを動きまわり敵と戦う。ここまで来ると限りなくアクション戦闘に近い。聖剣伝説シリーズ等も同様。
blocks.translation: You move freely around the map and fight enemies. At this point, it is extremely close to action combat. The Mana series and others are similar.

blocks.source: 複合型
blocks.translation: Hybrid

blocks.source: 複数のエンカウント方式を同時に採用する作品もある。可能ならば、いいとこ取りを狙ってみても良いだろう。
blocks.translation: Some games use multiple encounter methods simultaneously. If possible, you might try to combine the best aspects of each.

blocks.source: 【作品例】
blocks.translation: [Examples]

blocks.source: ポケモンシリーズ
blocks.translation: Pokémon series

blocks.source: フィールド上では、草むら等の特定の地形でのみポケモンが出現するランダムエンカウント。（ダンジョン内ではどこでもランダムエンカウント）。敵トレーナーに付いては、正面を通りかかると戦闘になる固定エンカウントになっている。
blocks.translation: Pokémon appear as random encounters only in specific terrain, such as tall grass, on the field. (Inside dungeons, random encounters can occur anywhere.) Enemy Trainers use fixed encounters, with battles starting when you pass in front of them.

blocks.source: ドラゴンクエスト８
blocks.translation: Dragon Quest VIII

blocks.source: 普段はランダムエンカウントだが、スカウトモンスター（ミニゲーム等で使用する）のみシンボルエンカウントとして登場する。
blocks.translation: The game normally uses random encounters, but Scout Monsters (used in minigames and the like) appear only as symbol encounters.

blocks.source: ライブアライブ
blocks.translation: Live A Live

blocks.source: 順序自由の章形式という体裁を取っているが、章によってエンカウント方式が異なる。『原始編』『幕末編』など、世界設定に合わせたエンカウント方式を採用している事も特徴。
blocks.translation: Although the game is structured around chapters that can be played in any order, the encounter method differs from chapter to chapter. Another notable feature is that the encounter method is tailored to each chapter's setting, such as the Prehistory and Twilight of Edo Japan chapters.

blocks.source: 原始編：透明なシンボルエンカウント。臭いによって、大まかな場所を知ることができる。
blocks.translation: Prehistory: Invisible symbol encounters. You can determine the general area by smell.

blocks.source: 幕末編：上述した通りの任意エンカウント。
blocks.translation: Twilight of Edo Japan: Optional encounters, as described above.

blocks.source: 現代編：ボス戦のみ。順序自由の固定エンカウント。
blocks.translation: Present Day: Boss battles only. Fixed encounters that can be fought in any order.

blocks.source: 近未来編：シンボルエンカウント。
blocks.translation: The Near Future: Symbol encounters.

blocks.source: 功夫編、西部編、ＳＦ編：主にイベント戦闘のみ。
blocks.translation: Imperial China, Wild West, and Distant Future: Primarily event battles only.

blocks.source: 中世編、最終編：ランダムエンカウント。
blocks.translation: Middle Ages and Final Chapter: Random encounters.

blocks.source: まとめ
blocks.translation: Summary

blocks.source: 最初に書いた通り、古くはランダムエンカウントが主流だったが、時代の流れと共に、シンボルエンカウントやシームレスの作品が非常に多くなっている。
blocks.translation: As I mentioned at the beginning, random encounters were once the norm, but over time, many more games have adopted symbol encounters or seamless encounters.

blocks.source: あのＤＱですら９作目（正確にはモンスターズジョーカーから）に至ってシンボルエンカウントへと転換した程だ。
blocks.translation: Even DQ eventually switched to symbol encounters with its ninth entry (more precisely, beginning with Dragon Quest Monsters: Joker).

blocks.source: 個人的にも、ランダムエンカウントよりも、シンボルエンカウント等を採用したほうが、プレイヤーが試行錯誤する余地が生まれるように思う。
blocks.translation: Personally, I feel that using symbol encounters or a similar system instead of random encounters gives players more room for trial and error.

blocks.source: ただし、上述した通り、シンボルエンカウントの実装にかかる工数は馬鹿にならない。技術や手間の都合もあるので、他の要素との兼ね合いも含めて検討しよう。
blocks.translation: However, as mentioned above, the amount of work required to implement symbol encounters is far from insignificant. Technical constraints and the time involved also need to be considered, so weigh this against the other elements of your game.

blocks.source: また、ランダムエンカウントであっても、工夫次第で化ける可能性もある……かも。
blocks.translation: Also, even random encounters might be transformed into something much better with a little ingenuity... maybe.

texts.エンカウントシステムとは、戦闘システムの入口に当たる部分であり、プレイヤーが敵と: An encounter system is the gateway to the battle system: it is the system that allows the player to begin battles with enemies.
texts.古くはドラクエシリーズを中心にランダムエンカウントが主流だったが、時代の変化と共: In the past, random encounters were the norm, particularly in the Dragon Quest series. However, as times have changed, various innovations have been introduced to this aspect as well.
texts.そこで既存のＲＰＧが、どの様な工夫を凝らしているのかをまとめてみた。: I therefore decided to summarize the various innovations used in existing RPGs.
texts.以下に、大雑把な分類を行うが、その分類の中であっても、作品によって様々な特徴付け: The following is a rough classification, but even within each category, individual games employ a variety of distinguishing features.
texts.具体的には『戦闘を回避する手段』や『戦闘前の駆け引き』といった要素で差別化するパ: In particular, many games seem to differentiate themselves through elements such as ways to avoid battles and pre-battle strategy.
texts.そのため、作品の例を挙げながら解説をしていきたい。: For that reason, I will explain each type while giving examples from various games.
texts.歩行時に確率等によって、戦闘に突入する古典的なエンカウントシステム。ＦＣ～ＰＳ時: This is a classic encounter system in which battles begin while walking, based on probability or similar factors. Most RPGs from the Famicom through PlayStation eras used this system. Strictly speaking, it is odd to call games that trigger battles after a fixed number of steps “random,” but I have classified them as the same type.
texts.地形によって戦闘に突入する確率を変更したり、敵の種類を変えたりといったような工夫: Games often include features such as changing the encounter rate or enemy types depending on the terrain.
texts.戦闘前の駆け引きがないので単調。: It is monotonous because there is no pre-battle strategy.
texts.視覚的に地味。（ただし、落ち着いているともいえる）: Visually unremarkable. (Though it could also be described as calm.)
texts.ランダムエンカウントといえば、かつてのドラクエシリーズ。: When you think of random encounters, you think of the classic Dragon Quest series.
texts.地形によってエンカウント率が変化したり、聖水によって弱い敵との戦闘を回避できる。: The encounter rate changes depending on the terrain, and Holy Water can be used to avoid battles with weak enemies.
texts.『エンカウントキャンセル』というシステムが特徴。: The series is known for its “Encounter Cancel” system.
texts.戦闘前にキャラクターの頭上に『！』のアイコンが表示されるので、そのタイミングでキ: An “!” icon appears above the character before battle. Pressing the cancel button at that moment allows you to avoid the battle. The conditions for successfully avoiding it vary from game to game.
texts.マップ上を動きまわる敵シンボルと接触することで、戦闘画面に切り替わる。: Touching an enemy symbol moving around the map switches the game to the battle screen.
texts.ＦＣ～ＰＳ時代は少数派だったが、ＰＳ２以降の作品では採用例も多くなっている。: This was uncommon during the Famicom through PlayStation eras, but it has been used much more frequently in games released since the PlayStation 2.
texts.敵に『当たるか』『避けるか』というように、プレイヤーが必要に応じて戦闘を行う事が: The player can choose whether to fight as needed—whether to engage an enemy or avoid it. With random encounters, the player absorbs some of the difficulty inherent in this decision, so in a sense, balancing the difficulty may be easier.
texts.「好みの敵種族を狙い撃ちする」「手強い敵を避ける」というように、プレイヤーが戦略: Players can also develop strategies, such as targeting their preferred enemy species or avoiding formidable enemies.
texts.敵シンボルによって、視覚的にマップを彩る効果がある。: Enemy symbols visually add color to the map.
texts.その時点では倒せない巨大モンスターが歩いているといった設定も可能。: It is also possible to have giant monsters roaming around that the player cannot defeat at that point in the game.
texts.シンボルのグラフィックを用意したり、配置したり、行動パターンをプログラムしたりと: It takes effort to prepare and place symbol graphics and program their behavior patterns.
texts.プレイヤーがシンボルを回避できるよう、マップにある程度の幅が必要となる。: The map needs to have a certain amount of space so that players can avoid the symbols.
texts.プレイスタイルの幅が広いため、制作者が予期しないことをするプレイヤーが出現しやす: Because the range of play styles is broad, players are more likely to do things the creator did not anticipate.
texts.避けやすいシンボルや、倒しても旨みのないシンボル等、全くプレイヤーに相手にされな: Some enemies may be completely ignored by players, such as symbols that are easy to avoid or provide little benefit even when defeated. And so on… This requires a different approach to balance adjustments than random encounters.
texts.筆者自身、シンボルエンカウントで長編を作成したけれど、特にマップの幅の問題は非常: I myself created a long game using symbol encounters, and the issue of map width in particular was extremely significant.
texts.細い道を軽々しく作れないため、マップ全体を大きめに作る必要がある。: Since narrow paths cannot be created casually, the entire map needs to be made relatively large.
texts.システム面の実装と合わせて、ゲーム全体の工数が馬鹿にならない規模でふくらむ可能性: Together with implementing the system itself, this can cause the total amount of work for the game to expand to a considerable scale.
texts.リンクの冒険（ディスクシステム）: Zelda II: The Adventure of Link (Disk System)
texts.ゼルダの伝説シリーズの第２作で、横スクロールアクション型の戦闘が特徴。: The second game in The Legend of Zelda series, it is known for its side-scrolling action-style battles.
texts.名作だがわりと存在を忘れられがちなゲーム。: It is a classic, but a game whose existence is fairly often forgotten.
texts.道の上は安全だが、道を外れると敵シンボルが出現し、近寄ってくる。: The roads are safe, but leaving them causes enemy symbols to appear and approach you.
texts.敵に触れた際の地形によって、戦闘内容が大きく変化する。: The content of the battle changes dramatically depending on the terrain where the enemy is touched.
texts.敵シンボルの色によって、敵の構成が変化する。: The enemy party changes depending on the color of the enemy symbol.
texts.ダンジョン内部に付いては、普通の横スクロール型アクションとなる。: Inside dungeons, the game becomes a standard side-scrolling action game.
texts.というように、１９８７年発売の作品ながら凝った構成。僕の知る限りでは、シンボルエ: Thus, despite being released in 1987, it has an elaborate structure. As far as I know, it is the oldest game to use symbol encounters.
texts.サガシリーズ（ロマンシングサガ以降）: The SaGa Series (From Romancing SaGa Onward)
texts.シンボルエンカウントといえばこのシリーズ。: When it comes to symbol encounters, this is the series that comes to mind.
texts.「敵の背後を取ると先制できる」: "You can get the first strike by getting behind an enemy."
texts.「ダッシュ中、敵に触れると陣形が崩れる」: "While dashing, touching an enemy disrupts your formation."
texts.というように戦闘開始時の状況によって、有利不利が変化する。: As in these examples, the advantages and disadvantages change depending on the situation at the start of battle.
texts.初代ロマンシングサガにおいて、草原を動きまわる恐竜（序盤に戦うと瞬殺）の姿が印象: In the original Romancing SaGa, the sight of dinosaurs roaming the grasslands (which can instantly kill you if fought early on) is particularly memorable.
texts.接触時、近くにいるシンボルも巻き込んで戦闘になる。それにより一度に戦う敵の数が決: When you make contact, nearby enemy symbols are also drawn into the battle. This determines how many enemies you fight at once. There is also the convenient feature that weak enemies can be instantly killed without even switching to the battle screen.
texts.エストポリス伝記２: Lufia II: Rise of the Sinistrals
texts.不思議のダンジョンシリーズのように、こちらが一歩動く度に敵シンボルも動く。弓矢で: As in the Mystery Dungeon series, enemy symbols move every time you move one step. You can also employ tactics such as shooting enemies with a bow and arrow to stop them from moving.
texts.他作品のいいとこ取りと言われる作品だが、何気にＲＰＧでこれを採用している作品は希: It is said to take the best elements from other games, but surprisingly few RPGs adopt this feature.
texts.ちなみに、フィールド上のみランダムエンカウントだったりする。: Incidentally, random encounters occur only in the field.
texts.特定の地点に必ず敵が存在する。シンボルエンカウントとは異なり避けられない相手も多: Enemies are always present at specific locations. Unlike symbol encounters, many of these opponents cannot be avoided. Honestly, considering the effort involved, I feel they offer little in terms of gameplay value, so I cannot particularly recommend using them as the default.
texts.プレイヤーの戦闘回数や得られる経験値を予想しやすい。: It is easy to predict how many battles the player will fight and how much experience they will gain.
texts.シンボルエンカウント同様に手間が掛かる。: They are just as much work as symbol encounters.
texts.特定の場所で必ず戦闘になるという仕組みはプレイヤーに取って面倒かも。: Having battles occur at specific locations every time may be a hassle for players.
texts.シンボルエンカウントとの複合型だが、進行上の強制戦闘も多い。戦闘突入前の敵のアク: It combines fixed encounters with symbol encounters, but it also has many forced battles required for progression. The enemies' actions before entering battle are elaborately designed. Although the transition to battle appears seamless, movement and battle are clearly separate.
texts.敵シンボルの場所が完全に固定されており、先に進むためには必ず敵と戦わなければなら: Enemy symbols are placed in completely fixed locations, and you must fight them to proceed.
texts.何というか分かりやすいゲームシステムではあるが、プレイの幅は狭い。: It is an easy-to-understand game system, in a sense, but it offers little variety in how you play.
texts.戦闘を行うかどうかを任意に決めることができる。ライブアライブの幕末編のように、仕: You can choose whether or not to engage in battle. It might work well in a game with plenty of mechanisms, such as the Bakumatsu chapter of Live A Live.
texts.なお、シンボルエンカウントについて回避を容易にした場合、実質的に任意エンカウント: Incidentally, if avoiding symbol encounters is made easy, they effectively become a form of optional encounter.
texts.基本的にはシンボルエンカウントと同じだが、利点も欠点も更に極端になる。バランス調: Basically, they are the same as symbol encounters, but both their advantages and disadvantages become more extreme. One approach is to insert forced encounters to make balance adjustments easier, but this also diminishes their distinctive character, making adjustment difficult.
texts.敵を『スキャン』することで、戦闘する敵を選ぶ方式。基本的には自分から仕掛けなけれ: You choose which enemies to fight by "scanning" them. Basically, enemies will not attack unless you initiate the encounter.
texts.ただし、このゲームの場合、シナリオ進行上で倒さなければならない敵もそれなりに存在: However, in this game, there are still a fair number of enemies that must be defeated to advance the story. Also, the latter half includes forced battles when changing maps, which can be a little tedious.
texts.主人公は忍者で『隠れ蓑』によって、姿を消す能力を持つ。というように、戦闘を避ける: The protagonist is a ninja who can conceal himself using "Disguise." Thus, avoiding battles is incorporated into the game system. Apart from bosses, there are no enemies that must be defeated, and even enemies in fixed locations can be ignored by using mechanisms or taking another route.
texts.ドラゴンクエストシリーズの銀の竪琴や＆口笛: Dragon Quest series' Silver Harp and & Whistle
texts.魔物を呼び出す効果を持つ。: They have the effect of summoning monsters.
texts.自由に戦闘を行えるので、任意エンカウントの一種と考えることができる。: Since you can engage in battles freely, they can be considered a type of optional encounter.
texts.画面の切り替わりなしで、その場でリアルタイム型の戦闘を行う。移動時と戦闘時の境界: Real-time battles take place on the spot without switching screens. The boundary between movement and battle is blurred.
texts.画面切り替えがないのでスムーズ。: The experience is smooth because there are no screen transitions.
texts.戦闘前の駆け引き要素を入れやすい。: It is easy to include tactical elements before battle.
texts.やはり手間が掛かる。特にプログラム的な難易度が高い。: They are still a lot of work. In particular, the programming difficulty is high.
texts.移動に操作を取られるため、複数キャラクターに命令できるようなシステムとの共存は難: Since the player must control movement, it is difficult to combine this with a system that allows commands to be issued to multiple characters. Battles can even become monotonous as a result.
texts.マップ上を動きまわる敵に対して、攻撃を仕掛けたり仕掛けられたりする事で、戦闘にな: Battles begin when you attack enemies moving around the map or are attacked by them. There are tactical decisions to make before battle, such as "Don't take on too many enemies at once" and "Don't pick a fight with a strong enemy." Xenoblade is similar.
texts.自由自在にマップを動きまわり敵と戦う。ここまで来ると限りなくアクション戦闘に近い: You move freely around the map and fight enemies. At this point, it is extremely close to action combat. The Mana series and others are similar.
texts.複数のエンカウント方式を同時に採用する作品もある。可能ならば、いいとこ取りを狙っ: Some games use multiple encounter methods simultaneously. If possible, you might try to combine the best aspects of each.
texts.フィールド上では、草むら等の特定の地形でのみポケモンが出現するランダムエンカウン: Pokémon appear as random encounters only in specific terrain, such as tall grass, on the field. (Inside dungeons, random encounters can occur anywhere.) Enemy Trainers use fixed encounters, with battles starting when you pass in front of them.
texts.普段はランダムエンカウントだが、スカウトモンスター（ミニゲーム等で使用する）のみ: The game normally uses random encounters, but Scout Monsters (used in minigames and the like) appear only as symbol encounters.
texts.順序自由の章形式という体裁を取っているが、章によってエンカウント方式が異なる。『: Although the game is structured around chapters that can be played in any order, the encounter method differs from chapter to chapter. Another notable feature is that the encounter method is tailored to each chapter's setting, such as the Prehistory and Twilight of Edo Japan chapters.
texts.原始編：透明なシンボルエンカウント。臭いによって、大まかな場所を知ることができる: Prehistory: Invisible symbol encounters. You can determine the general area by smell.
texts.幕末編：上述した通りの任意エンカウント。: Twilight of Edo Japan: Optional encounters, as described above.
texts.現代編：ボス戦のみ。順序自由の固定エンカウント。: Present Day: Boss battles only. Fixed encounters that can be fought in any order.
texts.功夫編、西部編、ＳＦ編：主にイベント戦闘のみ。: Imperial China, Wild West, and Distant Future: Primarily event battles only.
texts.中世編、最終編：ランダムエンカウント。: Middle Ages and Final Chapter: Random encounters.
texts.最初に書いた通り、古くはランダムエンカウントが主流だったが、時代の流れと共に、シ: As I mentioned at the beginning, random encounters were once the norm, but over time, many more games have adopted symbol encounters or seamless encounters.
texts.あのＤＱですら９作目（正確にはモンスターズジョーカーから）に至ってシンボルエンカ: Even DQ eventually switched to symbol encounters with its ninth entry (more precisely, beginning with Dragon Quest Monsters: Joker).
texts.個人的にも、ランダムエンカウントよりも、シンボルエンカウント等を採用したほうが、: Personally, I feel that using symbol encounters or a similar system instead of random encounters gives players more room for trial and error.
texts.ただし、上述した通り、シンボルエンカウントの実装にかかる工数は馬鹿にならない。技: However, as mentioned above, the amount of work required to implement symbol encounters is far from insignificant. Technical constraints and the time involved also need to be considered, so weigh this against the other elements of your game.
texts.また、ランダムエンカウントであっても、工夫次第で化ける可能性もある……かも。: Also, even random encounters might be transformed into something much better with a little ingenuity... maybe.
